purpose: Cynthion r1.4 TARGET-A VBUS/current diagnosis; bounded PAC1954 configuration only

pac1954.config_write_word: 0x4000 (channel-1 VSENSE bipolar ±100 mV; other ranges unipolar)
pac1954.refresh_command: REFRESH_V 0x1f Send Byte (activates configuration; no accumulator reset)
pac1954.shunt: 20,000 uOhm nominal, Cynthion r1.4 R2 ERJ-3BWFR020V
pac1954.current_scale: signed int16 * 5,000,000 / 32768 uA; positive means TARGET_A_to_CONTROL
pac1954.jtag_measurements: raw VBUS1 and signed-bipolar VSENSE1; host applies scales
